mapper.select: SELECT pts.tech_name AS techName, COUNT(*) AS demandCount FROM project_tech_stacks pts GROUP BY pts.tech_name ORDER BY demandCount DESC, techName ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT m.id AS memberId, m.nickname AS nickname, COUNT(*) AS completedCount FROM project_members pm INNER JOIN projects p ON pm.project_id = p.id AND p.status = 'COMPLETED' INNER JOIN members m ON pm.member_id = m.id GROUP BY m.id, m.nickname ORDER BY completedCount DESC, nickname ASC LIMIT #{limit}
